description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN opportunity offers flexibility, allowing you to make a significant impact on patients' recovery journeys while balancing your professional and personal life.

As a PTA, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, assisting patients with therapeutic exercises, functional training, and other rehabilitation activities. You will play a crucial role in implementing individualized treatment plans, documenting patient progress, and ensuring a supportive environment for healing. This role offers a competitive hourly rate.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program
Current state licensure as a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA)
Ability to work effectively in a rehabilitation team setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00 based on experience.

description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL, dedicated to providing exceptional patient care. We are actively seeking skilled and compassionate Rehabilitation Therapy Professionals, including Physical Therapists (PT), Occupational Therapists (OT), Speech-Language Pathologists (ST), Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA), and Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA), to enhance our dynamic team. This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on the lives of our residents, helping them achieve their rehabilitation goals in a supportive and collaborative environment.

We offer flexible full-time and part-time positions to accommodate your professional and personal needs. You will work alongside a dedicated team of healthcare professionals, utilizing your expertise to develop and implement individualized treatment plans. If you are passionate about rehabilitation and eager to contribute to a facility committed to excellence, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current state licensure/certification as a Physical Therapist (PT), Occupational Therapist (OT), Speech-Language Pathologist (ST), Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA), or Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA)
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation for Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA) and Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA) is $28.00 - $37.00/hr. Compensation for Physical Therapists (PT), Occupational Therapists (OT), and Speech-Language Pathologists (ST) is $40.00 - $46.00/hr.
